entities.name: Boris
entities.description: A burly Umbris cultist and trapper from Traublassen, son of Lord Vytas, who betrayed Torens and Aleksandar.

entities.name: Vytas
entities.description: Boris's father and leader of the Umbris cult.

entities.name: Torens
entities.description: Guided by Boris through the old keep; later confronted Umbris.

entities.name: Aleksandar
entities.description: Companion of Torens abandoned by Boris.

entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: A captured prophet who revealed the keep was a trap for sacrifices.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: A nightmare horror worshipped by the cult.

entities.name: Umbris cult
entities.description: Cult dedicated to worshipping Umbris, led by Vytas.

entities.name: Traublassen
entities.description: Town on Innistrad that is Boris's home.

entities.name: Taivas
entities.description: Boris's great-great-grandfather, who built a hellkite-embellished door.

events.summary: Torens and Aleksandar discover Boris and Vytas are Umbris cultists and meet the prophet Eruth, learning the keep is a sacrificial trap.
events.quote: the keep was a trap for sacrifices to their horrific master

events.summary: Boris is surrounded and caught by a vengeful mob along with the rest of the cult.
events.quote: Boris, along with the rest of the Umbris cult, was caught in this frenzy of justice and retribution.

relations.quote: Boris was revealed to be one of the cultists

rejected.summary: Boris is tasked by his father with guiding Torens through the old keep, then abandons Torens and Aleksandar and flees to town.
rejected.quote: Boris suddenly abandoned Torens and Aleksandar
